parameters.formDescription: Die Lizenz wird den Geraeten zugewiesen, die App ohne Apple-ID installiert und die Liste der erlaubten Apps aktualisiert.

values.fieldLabel: App-Store-ID oder Link (nur bei Andere App)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO automation.app_catalog (adam_id, name, bundle_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (adam_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, bundle_id = EXCLUDED.bundle_id, enabled = true
RETURNING adam_id
SELECT adam_id, name, bundle_id FROM automation.app_catalog WHERE enabled ORDER BY name

SELECT e.id AS enrollment_id, d.serial_number FROM public.enrollments e JOIN public.devices d ON d.id = e.device_id WHERE e.type = 'Device' AND e.enabled AND ($1::text IS NULL OR $1::text = '' OR d.serial_number = $1::text) ORDER BY d.serial_number

parameters.jsCode:
const crypto = require('crypto');
const apps = $('Auswahl bestimmen').first().json.apps;
const devices = $('Geraete suchen').all().map((item) => item.json).filter((row) => row.enrollment_id);
const out = [];
for (const device of devices) {
  for (const app of apps) {
    const commandUuid = crypto.randomUUID();
    const plist = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
'
      + '<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
'
      + '<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Command</key>
	<dict>
'
      + '		<key>ChangeManagementState</key>
		<string>Managed</string>
'
      + '		<key>Options</key>
		<dict>
			<key>PurchaseMethod</key>
			<integer>1</integer>
		</dict>
'
      + '		<key>RequestType</key>
		<string>InstallApplication</string>
'
      + '		<key>iTunesStoreID</key>
		<integer>' + Number(app.adamId) + '</integer>
'
      + '	</dict>
	<key>CommandUUID</key>
	<string>' + commandUuid + '</string>
</dict>
</plist>
';
    out.push({ json: { enrollment_id: device.enrollment_id, serial_number: device.serial_number, app: app.name, command_uuid: commandUuid, plist } });
  }
}
return out;

parameters.query:
UPDATE automation.profile_state p
SET params = jsonb_set(p.params, '{ALLOWED_APPS}', n.list), version = p.version + 1, updated_at = now()
FROM (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(b ORDER BY b), '[]'::jsonb) AS list
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(params->'SYSTEM_APPS') AS b FROM automation.profile_state WHERE name = 'app-allowlist'
    UNION
    SELECT bundle_id FROM automation.app_catalog WHERE enabled
  ) u
) n
WHERE p.name = 'app-allowlist' AND p.params->'ALLOWED_APPS' IS DISTINCT FROM n.list
RETURNING p.version

WITH claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO automation.device_profile AS d (enrollment_id, profile_name, version, state, claimed_at)
  SELECT e.id, p.name, p.version, 'claimed', now()
  FROM public.enrollments e CROSS JOIN automation.profile_state p
  WHERE e.type = 'Device' AND e.enabled AND p.name = 'app-allowlist' AND p.enabled
  ON CONFLICT (enrollment_id, profile_name) DO UPDATE
    SET version = EXCLUDED.version, state = 'claimed', claimed_at = now(), command_uuid = NULL, sent_at = NULL
    WHERE d.version < EXCLUDED.version OR d.state = 'failed'
  RETURNING d.enrollment_id, d.profile_name, d.version
)
SELECT c.enrollment_id, c.profile_name, c.version, p.template, p.params
FROM claimed c JOIN automation.profile_state p ON p.name = c.profile_name

UPDATE automation.device_profile
SET state = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN 'queued' ELSE 'failed' END,
    command_uuid = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN $3 ELSE NULL END,
    sent_at = now()
WHERE enrollment_id = $1 AND profile_name = $2
RETURNING enrollment_id, profile_name, state, $5::text AS detail

meta.description: Formular, das eine freigegebene App (Liste: automation.app_catalog, Start: ntfy, DLRG Trainer, Microsoft Teams), alle Apps der Liste oder eine neue kostenlose App per App-Store-ID installiert. Neue Apps werden ueber die iTunes-Lookup-API gepruefte (Name, Bundle-ID, kostenlos) und in den Katalog aufgenommen. Ablauf: Lizenz geraetegebunden zuweisen (POST /mdm/v2/assets/associate), InstallApplication (PurchaseMethod 1) einreihen, dann die Erlaubt-Liste (Profil app-allowlist, com.apple.applicationaccess allowListedAppBundleIDs) aus Systemapps plus Katalog neu berechnen und bei Aenderung an alle iPads senden. Die Liste greift nur auf beaufsichtigten Geraeten. Credentials: MDM Formulare, MDM NanoMDM API, MDM Automation DB, Apple Apps Token (Header Auth, Name Authorization, Wert Bearer <Server-Token aus Apple Business>), ntfy-publisher.
